news_rules_source: private original source; see source-identities.json for exact original SHA256
windows: [release-48h,release), recent[release-24h,release), older[release-48h,release-24h); exclude release exact second
scores: exact target ticker unique finite [-1,1]; mean across deterministic full-window-first URL/headline deduplicated stories; <=-.15 negative >=.15 positive else neutral; missing stays null
publication_qualification: vendor recorded exploratory; publisher primary null, no independently established original publication/syndication/PIT
correlations: exactly two NEW7-only average-tie-rank Spearman vs unchanged frozen opening gap and native5d sustain; available pairs separately n; no oldsample reruns/fitting/tuning
prior_outcome_exposure: selected cohort has already completed target and prior daily analysis; posthoc extension, not blinded forecasting

daily_behavior.episodes: 4 cached mature prior quarters plus fixed target per ticker; only already projected16 prior sessions and7 target sessions (AMC may6)
daily_behavior.gap: 100*(reactionday.open/priorclose-1); BMO prior session, AMC reported session
daily_behavior.sequence: first step reactionday.close versus reactionday.open; each later step current.close versus preceding.close, through unchanged native reported-sessionD+5. Ties flat. This is daily sampling, not continuous/intraday duration.
daily_behavior.daily_reversal: first daily closing step with strictly opposite nonzero sign to initial opening gap. Zero gap unavailable. Timestamp actual source session close from existing metadata if available; otherwise date-only, never assumed16:00. Right censored when no such step within fixed horizon.
daily_behavior.gapfill: first reaction-or-later daily close <=priorclose for positivegap or >=priorclose for negativegap; zero gap unavailable. Not proof of intraday touch.
daily_behavior.continuation: closing step strictly same sign as initial gap; count separately from flat/opposite, do not substitute for legacy sustain/flags
daily_behavior.quality: finite positive coherent native OHLC; volume>=0; dividend>=0; actualsplit must1 across episode; no normalize/factor1 invention; cashdiv recorded nominal no totalreturn; fixed supplied horizons/maturity/source basis preserved

intraday_inventory: count unique ticker-months covering fixed reaction-throughD+5 sampled windows only; no intraday reads authorized
